data.one_liner: Fully customizable top and bottom screen notifications with built-in themes and animations.
data.what_it_does: Displays customizable notifications (toasts) on top or at various screen alignments with animations, progress bars, and built-in themes like Success, Error, and Info. It supports stacked notifications, action widgets, and callback handlers for taps and dismissal.
use_when: You need to show styled pop-up alerts or feedback toasts at the top of the screen.
You want built-in themes for success, error, and info states.
You need stacked notifications or customized dismiss animations.
avoid_when: You are implementing cross-platform background push notifications (use a dedicated push notification plugin instead).
You need platform-native local notifications shown in the system tray.
strengths: Fully customizable dimensions, borders, colors, and shadows.
Built-in support for stacked toast options.
Includes success, error, and info preset themes.
weaknesses: No persistence or queue history tracking out of the box.
